implementation: Private 0700 user capture directory and 0600 regular lock path checks with O_NOFOLLOW.
Nonblocking cross-process flock acquisition bounded by the caller deadline; release in finally without unlinking the shared inode.
Unique .capture.png staging output preserves the existing gnome-screenshot -f argv and prevents stale destination reuse.
Strict Pillow PNG verify plus full decode and exact client dimensions before atomic os.replace publication.
Identity and publication deadline checks remain fail-closed; staging evidence is removed on all failures.
label: gnome-capture-r1
limitations: No real GUI capture or native calibration was run; this validates the production boundary with owned subprocess writers only.
Parent must independently reproduce and review before any read-only live verification.
